items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: I don't think he did so well. Because he got desponding up there and got to drinking. I think it was part of his downfall, you know. Because Big Ord, you see, he taught such men as Big Ord. Albert Nicholas and this boy Simeon from Chicago was his scholar.

ctx.x: What bands he worked with when he went back to New York?

No, I didn't know that because I stayed here. In fact, I don't think he did so well. Because he got desponding up there and got to drinking. I think it was part of his downfall, you know. Because Big Ord, you see, he taught such men as Big Ord. Albert Nicholas and this boy Simeon from Chicago was his scholar. And they all turned out to be great clarinet players, you see. So, when he got to New York, I learned that the, you know, fellas out here had helped him lean towards him and all. And that made him feel quite…
Did you say he was a good jazz clarinet player?
